Visually, both self-propel upstream through the developed wake and execute a large zig-zag; the faster pair cuts back earlier and approaches along the center wake corridor. I’ll record a one-sided local refinement hypothesis below the demonstrated `0.08` setting before touching the policy, as required by the visual-inspection skill.
